metaDesc: Meeting yourself, freeing yourself from the past and becoming the creator of your life: mediumistic consultations, leaving your personal matrix and quantum awakening workshops (5D School).
h1: Become the creator of your life
lede: Meeting yourself, freeing yourself from past wounds and transmuting fear into energy in the service of your mission, through mediumistic consultation, tools for leaving your personal matrix and the teaching of the 5D School.
intro: Revelations will multiply and lead humanity to awaken
4D energies are blowing the locks off the unconscious, which until now protected us.
Turning inward becomes essential, because the outside world is exploding.
Releasing your blocks and fears, calming your mind and stabilising your emotions open access to the consciousness of the Soul: this is what we call the second birth.
For the awakened human, enduring your life is over.
Having become an awakened human, the task now is to create it.
Vibrating as an incarnated Soul, the conscious human gains access to their multidimensionality.
